mapper.select: SELECT * FROM gw_code_group ORDER BY group_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_code_group (group_cd, group_nm, description, use_yn) VALUES (#{groupCd}, #{groupNm}, #{description}, COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'))
mapper.select: SELECT c.code_id, c.group_cd, g.group_nm, c.code_val, c.code_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.extra_val FROM gw_code c LEFT JOIN gw_code_group g ON g.group_cd = c.group_cd WHERE c.group_cd = #{groupCd} ORDER BY c.sort_no, c.code_val
SELECT c.code_id, c.group_cd, g.group_nm, c.code_val, c.code_nm, c.sort_no, c.use_yn, c.extra_val FROM gw_code c LEFT JOIN gw_code_group g ON g.group_cd = c.group_cd WHERE c.code_id = #{codeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO gw_code (group_cd, code_val, code_nm, sort_no, use_yn, extra_val) VALUES (#{groupCd}, #{codeVal}, #{codeNm}, COALESCE(#{sortNo}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn},'Y'), #{extraVal})
